title: Repo Docs Manifest
description: The contract emitted by the repo-level generator at <repo>/docs/manifest.json. It is the single seam between deliverables: publish adapters, the drift check, and the org search app all read this and nothing else. It doubles as the Bazel-style dependency record -- the per-doc covers[] edges are what make invalidation exact and incremental on merge instead of a full rebuild.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only on breaking shape changes so adapters can refuse mismatches loudly.

name.description: org/repo slug used as the org-app primary key.

commit.description: The exact SHA these docs were generated from -- the provenance anchor for the whole manifest.

generator.description: Everything needed to reason about reproducibility. The hermetic claim is auditable from here: pinned versions + (for the LLM) provider/model/temperature/promptHash.

render.description: Resolved rendering config (from built-in < org base < repo docgen.yaml < CLI flags). WHY it lives here: these are generation INPUTS, so they feed every diagram's inputsHash -- recording them is what keeps the hermetic claim honest. Change the palette and inputsHash changes, forcing regeneration.

diagramFormats.description: Every rendition the generator emitted. The org app picks per surface (mermaid on web, ascii in an incident CLI).

palette.description: Named accessible palette, or 'custom' with explicit themeVariables.

themeVariables.description: Explicit Mermaid theme vars when palette=custom (e.g. colorblind-safe hexes).

llm.description: Present only for non-hermetic (Explanation) generation. Pinned so the same inputs are as reproducible as a provider allows.

promptHash.description: sha256 of the frozen prompt template.

toolchain.description: Pinned versions of every reference generator and the graph engine. WHY: the Reference quadrant's hermetic guarantee is only meaningful if these are fixed.

graph.description: The codebase-memory-mcp snapshot the run read. snapshotHash pins the graph so a doc's inputsHash is fully determined.

docs.description: One entry per emitted doc file. The org app ingests this array directly; the drift check diffs covers[] against changed symbols.

quadrant.description: Divio number range start, mirrors documentation.md. Absent for flat profile.

hermetic.description: true => byte-reproducible from inputsHash (Reference). false => LLM-written (Explanation) -- regenerate-and-review, not rebuild-blindly.

authored.description: Who owns the content. 'stub' = scaffolded placeholder the generator may overwrite; 'human' = hand-written, NEVER overwritten; 'generated' = tool output, safe to regenerate.

contentHash.description: sha256 of rendered bytes -- change detection + org-app cache key.

inputsHash.description: sha256 of (graph subset + source slices + prompt/toolchain pins) that produced this doc. Equal inputsHash => skip regeneration. This is the Bazel action cache key.

covers.description: The dependency edges back to code. On merge, intersect changed nodes with every doc's covers[]; only intersecting docs are stale. Exact invalidation, no semantic guessing.

summary.description: One-line, indexed by the org search app for result snippets.

diagrams.description: Diagram renditions attached to this doc. A doc can carry several formats of the SAME diagram (mermaid for web, ascii for terminal). Each is a separate artifact so the org app renders the right one per surface.

path.description: Repo-relative file, when rendered to a separate artifact.

inline.description: true if embedded directly in the doc body instead of a file.

palette.description: Resolved palette for this rendition; overrides generator.render.mermaid.palette.

source.description: Repo-relative file the ref lives in.

graphNodeId.description: codebase-memory-mcp node id, when known -- lets the org app join straight to the graph.
